_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd insurgency_sandstorm/egg-insurgency--sandstorm.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Upstream has no uuid; Octail gives it a fixed one so re-imports update the egg. Octail adds the insurgency-sandstorm tag, an automatic query port (no longer editable by customers), Source RCON (-Rcon -RconPassword -RconListenPort) on an automatic port with a generated password (console commands go over it), a broadcast command, install sandbox defaults and resource hints, and makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration".
name: Insurgency: Sandstorm
author: brycea@terrahost.cloud
description: Insurgency: Sandstorm is a team-based, tactical FPS based on lethal close quarters combat and objective-oriented multiplayer gameplay. Experience the intensity of modern combat where skill is rewarded, and teamwork wins the fight.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian'

##
#
# Variables
# STEAM_USER, STEAM_PASS, STEAM_AUTH - Steam user setup. If a user has 2fa enabled it will most likely fail due to timeout. Leave blank for anon install.
# WINDOWS_INSTALL - if it's a windows server you want to install set to 1
# SRCDS_APPID - steam app id found here - https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Dedicated_Servers_List
# SRCDS_BETAID - beta branch of a steam app. Leave blank to install normal branch
# SRCDS_BETAPASS - password for a beta branch should one be required during private or closed testing phases.. Leave blank for no password.
# INSTALL_FLAGS - Any additional SteamCMD  flags to pass during install.. Keep in mind that steamcmd auto update process in the docker image might overwrite or ignore these when it performs update on server boot.
# AUTO_UPDATE - Adding this variable to the egg allows disabling or enabling automated updates on boot. Boolean value. 0 to disable and 1 to enable.
#
 ##


## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## other flags may be needed depending on install. looking at you cs 1.6
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/Insurgency/Binaries/Linux/InsurgencyServer-Linux-Shipping" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Insurgency: Sandstorm dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## add below your custom commands if needed

cp -v /mnt/server/steam/linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
chmod +x /mnt/server/Insurgency/Binaries/Linux/InsurgencyServer-Linux-Shipping

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: App ID
variables.description: The ID corresponding to the game to download and run. Leave blank to avoid auto update.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name to appear in the server in the server list.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port. Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Sets the maximum number of players.

variables.name: Default Map
variables.description: Default map to run when starting the server. Scenario must be available with the provided map.

variables.name: Scenario Name
variables.description: By default, a server will cycle through all Versus (PVP) scenarios available.

variables.name: Additional Switches
variables.description: Please see this guide for available switches https://mod.io/g/insurgencysandstorm/r/server-admin-guide

variables.name: Game Stats Token
variables.description: Generate your token here https://gamestats.sandstorm.game/. This is required to have your server show up in the server browser.

variables.name: GSLT Authentication
variables.description: Generate your token here https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers. This is required to have your server show up in the server browser.

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: RCON port (TCP), passed as -RconListenPort=. Set by Octail when the server is created (two after the game port).

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Generated by Octail when the server is created. Octail sends console commands over RCON.
